# MediaFlow Studio 1.2.0 — AI Enhance

## ✨ What's new

### 🪄 New tool: AI Enhance
A fifth tool in the sidebar, with two modes — drop your videos, pick a mode, click **Enhance**.

| | Mode | What it does |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| 🔍 | **Upscaling** | Sharper, bigger video with **Real-ESRGAN** — up to 720p, 1080p, 1440p or **4K**. *Fast* model for everyday clips, *Best quality* for the cleanest detail on real footage. |
| 🎞️ | **Interpolation** | Smoother motion with **RIFE** — new in-between frames up to **60 fps** (great for slow motion, 24/30 fps clips, screen recordings). |

- Runs **100% locally** on your graphics card — NVIDIA, AMD or Intel (Vulkan). Nothing is uploaded.
- Final encode on your GPU as usual (NVENC / Quick Sync / AMF), high-quality H.264, all audio tracks kept.
- A target lower than your video simply downscales / drops frames — no AI needed.
- Clear progress on long jobs: *AI upscaling · 2:10 left*, *AI interpolation*… cancel anytime.
- Processed in small chunks, so even 4K never fills your disk. HDR and variable-frame-rate clips are prepared automatically.
- Files are named clearly: `clip Upscaled.mp4`, `clip Interpolated.mp4`.

### 🎛️ Also
- Advanced settings in the Converter now only apply while **Advanced** mode is open — Simple mode is always just the preset.

Already on 1.1.x? The app offers this update automatically — click **Update**, then **Restart & Install**.
